_comment: Hand-maintained corrections applied by tools/build_db.py on top of the vocabulary document.
Every entry is echoed into review.csv so Sonia can see and change it.
Keys: fallback, unapproved, notes, intent, canonical, addKeywords, removeKeywords, removeGenerated, reRecorded.
Keywords are normalised (lowercase, no accents) when applied, so accents here are fine.

unapproved.020: Label looks wrong: 'Ken moijtos ika nawatlajtoli' means 'how do you say ... in Náhuatl', not 'buenas noches'. Compare 016/107.
unapproved.065: Label looks wrong: 'Xikpouakan' is 'cuenten' (see 064 'Xikpouakan temej' = 'cuenten piedras'), not 'piedras' (102 Tetl).

notes.093: Also used as the fallback clip ('otra vez' = please say it again).
notes.028: Same word as 090 with modern spelling (Siwatl / Siuatl). Both kept, 028 is canonical.
notes.049: 'bien gracias' added as a keyword (judgment call): a child answering 'bien, gracias' should hear this clip rather than 068.
notes.055: 'buenos dias' added as a keyword (judgment call): its Náhuatl is the bare greeting, 049/052 carry extra words.
notes.041: 'no llora' / 'no llore' added (judgment call): children conjugate loosely; both should reach 'no llores'.
notes.103: 'buho' added as a synonym of tecolote.
notes.048: Compound sentence (046 + 047 + 051). Only the whole sentence is a keyword so it cannot steal 'maestro' or 'amigos'.

reRecorded.note: Replaced on Drive on 2026-10-14; matches the Toño_Vocabulario list, i.e. a second speaker.

048: me llamo daniel y soy maestro
